title: Add accountId to every VTC ephemeral event
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Add accountId to every VTC ephemeral event
Spec (9d02170): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md L296-303: "When delivered over the WebSocket, every event in this table carries an `accountId` (String) property in addition to the properties defined in {{JMAP-VTC}}: the id of the call's hosting account ... This applies whether the event is delivered through `VTCStreamEnable` or through `ChatStreamEnable`"
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:88; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:110; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:129; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:157; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:181; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:201; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:219; crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/event.rs:242; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs:671-676
Now: None of the eight event structs has an account_id field: an incoming accountId falls into `extra`. The server builds VTCRecordingStateEvent (media.rs:671) without accountId, so emitted events lack the now-required property.
Change: Add `pub account_id: Id` to all eight event structs. Fill it with the hosting account in media.rs deliver(), and in any other event builder.
